LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Entity.Line.0: {PAWN} accepted the kiss the way a door accepts a push — it learned this gesture long ago, and nobody is watching inside anymore.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Entity.Line.1: Somewhere inside {PAWN} an impulse to respond began, completed half its arc, and dissolved before it ever became an act.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Entity.Line.2: {PAWN} made a sound halfway between a word and a groan. The colony's linguist has officially stopped translating.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Entity.Line.3: {PAWN} attended the whole kiss the way an empty room attends a concert: everything happened, nothing arrived.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Entity.Line.4: Whatever {PAWN} used to be, it kissed back out of pure habit — and the habit is all that came back.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Entity.Line.5: The kiss landed somewhere deep in {PAWN}'s old habits, one floor above whatever was taken away.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Entity.Line.6: For one flicker {PAWN} nearly said something addressed to {WALL}. The flicker went out, politely.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Entity.Line.7: {PAWN} did not kiss back, did not pull away, did not comment. Everyone agrees this counts as responsive.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Entity.Line.8: The hollow one tolerated the kiss the way a house tolerates a letter slipped under the door: received, unread.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Entity.Line.9: Somewhere inside {PAWN}, something that might once have been amusement stirred, found no one to report to, and settled again.
